spans.s:
गोष्ठः,
 
-ष्ठम् [गावस्तिष्ठन्त्यत्र घञ्र्थे क षत्वम्] (Usually गोष्ठम् only) 
__1 A cow-pen, cow-house, cow-station. 
__2 A station of cowherds. 
__3 An abode, place of living; गोष्ठान् हरीणां गिरिसेतुमालाः [[

.]] 
-ष्ठः 
__1 An assembly or meeting. 
__2 An epithet of Śiva. 
-ष्ठम् A purificatory श्राद्ध ceremony; वाच्यं गोष्ठे तु सुश्रुतम् [[

.]] °पतिः a chief herdsman. °वेदिका a mound or altar in a cow-pen. °श्वः a dog in a cow-pen which barks at every one; applied figuratively to a slanderous person, one who stays idly at home and slanders his neighbours. गोष्ठेपण्डितः ‘wise in a cow-pen,’ a braggart, vain boaster. गोष्ठेक्ष्वेडिन् m. a boasting coward; also गोष्ठपटु, गोष्ठेप्रगल्भः, -शूरः &c.

__1 A cow's foot. 
__2 The mark or impression of a cow's foot in the soil. 
__3 The quantity of water sufficient to fill such an impression; i. e. a very small puddle; गोष्पदे संप्लुतोदके [[
.]] °प्रम् (णमुल्) in such a manner that a cow's footprint be filled; ददाल भूर्नभो रक्तं गोष्पदप्रं ववर्ष च [[

.]] 
__4 As much as a cows foot-step will hold. 
__5 A spot frequented by cows.

-ष्ठी f. 
__1 An assembly, meeting; मध्ये विरेजतुरलं पशुपालगोष्ठन्यां रङ्गे यथा नटवरौ क्व च गायमानौ [[

.]] 
__2 Society, association. 
__3 Conversation, chitchat, discourse; क्वचिद्विद्वद्गोष्ठी क्वचिदपि सुरामत्तकलहः [[

.]] 
__4 A multitude or collection; मोदन्तां सततं च बान्धवसुहृद्गोष्ठीप्रमोदाः प्रजाः [[

.]] 
__5 Family connections, relatives, especially such as require to be maintained. 
__6 A kind of dramatic composition in one act. °पतिः 
__1 the chief of an assembly, president. 
__2 the master of a family.

[गां जलं स्यति सो-क] 
__1 Gum myrrh. 
__2 Early morning, day-break. 
__3 Hot season. 
-Comp. 
-गृहम् an inner apartment.
